mapper.select: SELECT tb.mrkt_idx_anly_tgt_cd , tb.prdc_fulf_dt , tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_dtl_cd , tb.prdc_inpt_mnmnc_cd , tb.expp_lvl_dtl_nm , tb.expp_scre , tb.expp_rnk , tb.mnmnc_cd , tb.expp_dir_symb_nm , RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tb.expp_dir_symb_nm ORDER BY tb.expp_rnk) AS dir_rank FROM tmm_bztgtprdcexppinfom tb WHERE ${queryWhere} AND tb.expp_lvl_nm = #{explanatoryLevelNm} AND tb.prdc_fulf_dt = #{predictDate} AND tb.expp_dir_symb_nm = #{direction} AND tb.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY tb.expp_rnk LIMIT #{limit}
